title: Medeniyetlerin Şafağı
author: Töre Sivrioğlu
description: The Mediterranean region captivates with its deep blue waters, rugged coastal landscapes, and lush olive groves, but millions of years ago it was a land of deserts, steppes, and shrinking salt lakes. In a geological instant, water levels rose, connecting land masses and nurturing some of history’s most fascinating civilizations. Archaeologist Ulaş Töre Sivrioğlu invites readers on a compelling journey to uncover the mysteries of these ancient societies. Blending rigorous scholarship with myth and imagination, this book explores the dawn of civilizations and the enduring legacies of their discoveries.
english_title: The Dawn Civilizations: The Story of Mediteranean
